stories.title: Centenarian gets 600 birthday cards after appeal
stories.summary: Reynolds Bowen says he is "amazed" after receiving hundreds of cards from around the world.

stories.title: Police go undercover to protect female runners
stories.summary: An undercover operation launches after a survey finds about 80% of female runners have felt scared.

stories.title: New digital in-cab signalling system on railway
stories.summary: Work to replace traditional lineside signals continues on the East Coast Main Line.

stories.title: Post-mortem exam finds woman died from stab wound
stories.summary: A 62-year-old man suspected of killing Vera Jaunzeme, 61, in Wisbech remains in hospital.

stories.title: City centre's £90m refurbishment gets approval
stories.summary: A civic building, entertainment hall and the market place are all getting refurbished or overhauled.

stories.title: Train driver recalls 'horrifying' knife attack on board
stories.summary: Andrew Johnson called a signal operator to warn "There's a knifeman on board stabbing people" and urged them to call police.

stories.title: 'We only had a few seconds to save passengers'
stories.summary: Andrew Johnson recalls driving the train at 122mph when an emergency alarm sounded.

stories.title: 'I wouldn't be here today without you': Student's praise for man who stopped train attacker
stories.summary: Astrid credits Stephen Crean with saving her life during the Huntingdon train attack last year.

stories.title: Review set into scrapped car park development plans
stories.summary: The plans involved building 250 homes on council-owned car parks in St Neots, St Ives and Huntingdon.

stories.title: Weekend service disruption on East Coast Main Line
stories.summary: Work on the line south of Peterborough includes upgrading signalling and replacing track.

stories.title: Rail firm donates lost property to women's refuges
stories.summary: Refuges can request items which are then sent through secure lockers to retain confidentiality.

stories.title: Police apologise over train knifeman failings
stories.summary: The Cambridgeshire force admits errors that may have prevented the attempted murders of 14 people.
